name: access-certificate-modes

protocol.note: arena holds one allocation the compiled module statically touches and one it does not, so CertifiedPinned's certified set (1 reference) is distinguishable from Universe/DiscoverThenLease's full-arena set (2 references)

judgement: CertifiedPinned/Universe/DiscoverThenLease each produce a real, epoch-stamped AccessCertificate on both backends (ADR-025); SoftwarePaged/FaultManaged are honestly reported LoweringClass::Unsupported on both backends rather than approximated -- under this project's unified-memory Metal/reference model there is no GPU-resident subset distinct from the arena itself, so DiscoverThenLease's discovery break-even is degenerate (it certifies the same set as Universe, at additional measured host-rescan cost) rather than a smaller leased subset; this is an accurate adapter result, not a gap. Vulkan is compile-review-only per ADR-024 and is not a backend for this experiment's actual results.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024); vulkan_device_hal.cpp does not implement requested_certificate_mode in this milestone
